column1: # manifests/components.tsv -- NCZ-OS component registry (Item C1, phase 1)
# Operator directive 2026-10-05. TSV; one component per row. Generated by
# post-install hook installs; audited by `build/components.py check`.
#   name            package name, or curated identifier for kernel / DKMS /
#   kind            debian | ncz-apt | staged-deb | npm | dkms | kernel |
#   version_floor   minimum acceptable version (semver-ish or kver); empty
#   installed_by    hook or build script, or 'manifest' (install implicit
#   verified_by     verify*/check* script(s) that audit the install
#   notes           free-form, single line, no tabs
# Phases: phase 1 seeded this registry; phase 2 enforces required/floor/arch
# (K2 aer9011, T1 DKMS policy, S4 screensaver floor, S7 r285 overlays);
# phase 3 generates seed files and mirror rows from this registry.
